claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: GW-441756 is a selective TrkA (NTRK1) inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is expected to produce little or no cytotoxicity, since TrkA signaling is dispensable for survival in most cell lines and the compound lacks a broadly cytotoxic off-target at this concentration.
